mentions.name: Doodlemate
mentions.description: This web app animates hand drawn human characters by auto-rigging the drawings in just a few seconds. It does not use generative AI and can be tried without any login.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a web app that animates hand drawn human characters. You try it here without any login or anything:

http://doodlemate.com

It doesn't use generative AI, instead it auto-rigs the drawings in just a few seconds.
